snippet.title: Lazare's Sacrifice - World Premiere Trailer | The Triple-i Initiative
snippet.description:
Learn more about Lazare's Sacrifice: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4870080/Lazares_Sacrifice/

Lazare's Sacrifice is a narrative deckbuilder set at the height of the French Revolution, where every night brings a new opponent and every hand could be your last.

Armed with nothing but a deck of cards, summon powerful figures to the board and fight for your life. Sacrifice everything you have; cards, slots, even your own life to see one more dawn. But win or lose, the truth behind your imprisonment lies buried just a few cards away…

Will you uncover it before the guillotine's blade finds you? Lazare's Sacrifice comes to Steam Spring 2027.

Lazare's Sacrifice Store Page:
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4870080/Lazares_Sacrifice/

Follow news and updates on The Triple-i Initiative:
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/sale/triple-i-initiative-2026 
Bluesky: https://bsky.app/profile/iii-initiative.bsky.social 
Bilibili: https://space.bilibili.com/3546638813497663
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/iii_initiative/
Twitter: https://x.com/iii_initiative

What is the Triple-i Initiative?

We’re simply a bunch of studios banding together to share exciting news to our players, in a short show packed with back-to-back trailers. That’s it - no extra fluff, no ads, no host, just games. We’re talking world premieres, exclusive gameplay, launch dates, demo drops and more!

You can learn more at https://iii-initiative.com
